note: Installable skills. Each entry is cloned from `git`; `subdir` picks one skill out of a repository that ships several. Paths and descriptions here were taken from the repositories themselves, not guessed — an entry whose subdir has no SKILL.md fails the install rather than copying something arbitrary. Kept in-repo so installs work offline and changes show up in a diff; the loader is written so this can come from a URL later.
